statements: The making and reviewing of an integration joint board's strategic plan is governed by Part 2 of the Public Bodies (Joint Working) (Scotland) Act 2014, sections 29 to 38.

Section 29 requires the strategic plan to set out the arrangements for carrying out the integration functions and how those arrangements are intended to achieve the national health and wellbeing outcomes, and to divide the area into two or more localities with the arrangements set out separately for each.
Section 33 prescribes a three-stage consultative sequence with the strategic planning group and wider consultees, proposals then a first draft then a second draft, before the plan may be finalised.
Section 37(1)(a) requires the board to review the effectiveness of the strategic plan before the expiry of each three-year relevant period, and section 37(1)(b) permits a review at any other time.
Section 38 allows the constituent authorities acting jointly to direct the board to prepare a replacement strategic plan, and the board must comply with such a direction.
